title: MetalLib
description: A library mod that adds metals
body:
A library mod that adds metals. This mod is not intended for standalone use. İf you are a mod author and want to use my library visit [this page](https://github.com/Po2432/MetalLib/wiki/Using-Library) for more info.

The mod currently adds:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Aluminium
- Bauxite
- Volfram
- Creative Metal
</details>

More Metals Coming Soon !

For license info visit [this page](https://github.com/Po2432/MetalLib/wiki/License).
